children: The 4.2-metre SUV gets a generative AI voice assistant, petrol powertrain and manual and IVT transmission options

Hyundai Motor India has opened bookings for the Bayon, its upcoming 4.2-metre intelligent utility vehicle, ahead of its festive-season launch. Customers can book the SUV for an initial amount of Rs 11,000 through Hyundai’s website or authorised dealerships across India.

The Bayon will be offered with a petrol powertrain and manual and Intelligent Variable Transmission (IVT) options. Hyundai has not yet disclosed the engine specifications, prices, variants or detailed feature list.

The key technology feature in the Bayon is an in-built generative artificial intelligence (AI) voice assistant. Hyundai said the system is designed to enable more natural interactions between the driver and vehicle as part of its ‘Intelligence That Moves’ approach.

The SUV has been developed around five areas — intelligence, safety, comfort, performance and style. Its exterior features include a sculpted bonnet, H-Edge LED daytime running lights (DRLs), geometric wheel arches, wrap-around door cladding and bridge-type roof rails.

Hyundai said the Bayon is based on its Global K Enhanced Platform, which has been engineered for 5-star Indian safety standards. The company has highlighted occupant protection, structural rigidity and safety engineering, although an independent crash-test rating for the India-spec model has not yet been announced.

Measuring 4.2 metres in length, the Bayon is positioned in the mid-size SUV segment. Hyundai said its proportions and cabin layout have been designed to provide adequate legroom, headroom and shoulder room for occupants.
The Bayon is scheduled to arrive during the festive season. Hyundai will announce pricing and delivery details at the time of launch.
